Name: PylePro - 400-Watt 5.1 Channel Home Theater System with AM/FM Tuner, CD, DVD & MP3 Player Compatible
Natural: The Pyle PT628A is an All-in-One 5.1 home theater system. A big television may impress your eyes, but when it comes to realism, sound is the king. The PT628A includes four satellite speakers, a center channel speaker and a 150 watt subwoofer that booms, thanks to a 10" long throw driver. The satellites and center speaker are 50 watts each and feature 3" mid-range drivers, for a total of 400 watts of sound. Connect your equipment safely using the gold-capped AV cables and wires. The digital VFD display displays relevant information without distracting you. Control everything using the included wireless remote control.You get four satellite speakers plus a center channel and a subwoofer for a full, rich experience that envelopes you in sound as you watch your favorite dramatic TV shows, films and sporting events. The PT628A packs an amplifier, pre-amplifier and AM/FM tuner to get you started.
